---
title = "Template Variable Reference"
---

Templates use two namespaces: `cfg.*` for user-authored values (front matter, attributes) and `clp.*` for engine-computed values (rendered content, metadata). Chunk options and div attributes are passed through as-is to `cfg.*`.

## Universal variables

Available in every element template:

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `clp.content` | Rendered content of the element |
| `cfg.id` | Element identifier (for cross-refs, HTML id, LaTeX label) |
| `cfg.classes` | Space-separated CSS class list |


## Main template

The document shell (`main.html`, `main.tex`, `main.typ`).

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `clp.body` | Rendered document body |
| `clp.toc` | Table of contents block |
| `clp.preamble` | Extra preamble from code chunks |
| `clp.appendix` | Appendix block (license, citation, copyright, funding) |
| `clp.authors` | Rendered author block |
| `clp.bibliography` | Bibliography section (LaTeX, Typst) |
| `clp.css` | Default CSS (HTML) |
| `clp.js` | JavaScript block (HTML) |
| `clp.math` | Math library includes (HTML) |
| `cfg.title` | Document title (with inline markdown rendered) |
| `cfg.title_plain` | Document title (plain text, for `<title>` and metadata) |
| `cfg.subtitle` | Document subtitle |
| `cfg.date` | Document date |
| `cfg.lang` | Language code (default: `"en"`) |
| `cfg.keywords` | Comma-separated keywords |
| `cfg.authors` | Structured author list (see Authors below) |


## Authors template

The `authors` template receives structured data:

| Variable | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `cfg.authors` | list | Each item has `.name`, `.superscripts`, `.corresponding`, `.orcid_url`, `.email`, `.mailto` |
| `cfg.affiliations` | list | Each item has `.number`, `.display` |

Example usage:

```jinja
{% for a in cfg.authors %}
  {{ a.name }}{% if a.corresponding %} *{% endif %}
{% endfor %}
```


## Element templates

### figure

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `cfg.id` | Figure label (e.g., `fig-myplot`) |
| `cfg.caption` | Figure caption |
| `clp.content` | Rendered image tag or div children |

Pass-through attributes: `cfg.fig_pos`, `cfg.fig_scap`, `cfg.fig_width`, `cfg.fig_height`, `cfg.fig_link`.

### table

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `cfg.id` | Table label |
| `cfg.caption` | Table caption |
| `clp.content` | Rendered table content |

Pass-through: `cfg.tbl_pos`.

### code_source

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `cfg.lang` | Language identifier |
| `cfg.filename` | Filename header (if set) |
| `clp.content` | Syntax-highlighted (HTML/LaTeX) or escaped (Typst/Markdown) code |

### code_output

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `clp.content` | Code execution output |

### code_diagnostic

Shared by warnings, messages, and errors.

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `cfg.type` | Diagnostic type: `warning`, `message`, or `error` |
| `clp.content` | Diagnostic text |

### code_listing

Wraps a code chunk that has a `lst-` label prefix.

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `cfg.id` | Listing label |
| `cfg.caption` | Listing caption |
| `clp.number` | Auto-incremented listing number |
| `clp.content` | Rendered code block |

### callout_*

Five variants: `callout_note`, `callout_tip`, `callout_warning`, `callout_caution`, `callout_important`.

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `cfg.title` | Custom title (defaults to type name) |
| `cfg.id` | Element id |
| `clp.content` | Callout body |

### theorem

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `clp.type_class` | Type name (e.g., `theorem`, `lemma`, `definition`) |
| `clp.number` | Auto-incremented number |
| `cfg.id` | Element id |
| `clp.content` | Theorem body |

### proof

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `cfg.id` | Element id |
| `clp.content` | Proof body |

### equation

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `cfg.id` | Equation label |
| `clp.content` | Math expression (with `$$` delimiters for HTML, raw for others) |

### layout, layout_row, layout_cell

| Variable | Template | Description |
|----------|----------|-------------|
| `clp.rows` | layout | Rendered rows |
| `clp.is_figure` | layout | Whether layout is inside a figure |
| `cfg.caption` | layout | Caption (if figure) |
| `cfg.id` | layout | Label (if figure) |
| `clp.cells` | layout_row | Rendered cells |
| `clp.columns` | layout_row | Column widths (HTML/Typst) |
| `clp.align_items` | layout_row | Vertical alignment (HTML) |
| `clp.content` | layout_cell | Cell content |
| `clp.valign` | layout_cell | Vertical alignment (LaTeX) |
| `clp.width` | layout_cell | Cell width fraction (LaTeX) |

### tabset

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `cfg.group` | Tab group name (for synchronized tabs) |
| `clp.nav_items` | Rendered tab buttons |
| `clp.tab_panes` | Rendered tab content panels |

### video

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `cfg.url` | Raw video URL |
| `cfg.title` | Video title |
| `cfg.width` | Width |
| `cfg.height` | Height |
| `clp.url` | Processed embed URL (YouTube/Vimeo) |
| `clp.is_embed` | Whether the URL is an embed (iframe vs video tag) |

### Other elements

| Template | Key variables |
|----------|---------------|
| `div` | `cfg.classes`, `cfg.id`, `clp.content` |
| `span` | `cfg.classes`, `cfg.id`, `clp.content` |
| `aside` | `clp.content` (margin note) |
| `landscape` | `cfg.id`, `clp.content` |
| `pagebreak` | (none) |
| `placeholder` | `cfg.width`, `cfg.height`, `cfg.text` |
| `emphasis` | `cfg.text` |
| `superscript` | `cfg.text` |
| `url` | `cfg.url`, `cfg.label` (display text) |
| `footnotes` | `clp.content` (rendered footnote list, HTML only) |
| `toc` | `cfg.title`, `clp.content` (HTML list) |
| `math` | (none, static KaTeX include) |

### Metadata templates

Rendered into the main template's `clp.appendix` block:

| Template | Key variables |
|----------|---------------|
| `abstract` | `cfg.abstract` |
| `keywords` | `cfg.keywords` |
| `title` | `cfg.title` |
| `subtitle` | `cfg.subtitle` |
| `date` | `cfg.date` |
| `appendix` | `clp.content` (joined sections) |
| `citation` | `clp.content` (formatted citation text) |
| `copyright` | `clp.content` (formatted copyright text) |
| `license` | `clp.content`, `clp.url` |
| `funding` | `clp.items` (list of strings) |
| `bibliography` | `cfg.path` (bibliography file path) |
| `preamble` | (format-specific setup, no variables) |


## Website templates

Website templates receive all variables under `clp.*`.

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `clp.title` | Site title |
| `clp.subtitle` | Page subtitle |
| `clp.abstract` | Page abstract |
| `clp.date` | Page date |
| `clp.body` | Rendered page content |
| `clp.toc` | Table of contents HTML |
| `clp.css` | Stylesheet |
| `clp.math` | Math library includes |
| `clp.dark_mode` | Dark mode enabled |
| `clp.favicon` | Favicon path |
| `clp.lang` | Current page language code |
| `clp.languages` | Available languages list |
| `clp.source_url` | Path to `.qmd` source |
| `clp.pages` | Navigation tree (list of `PageNode`) |
| `clp.navbar` | Navbar config (`.left`, `.middle`, `.right`) |
| `clp.breadcrumbs` | Breadcrumb trail |
| `clp.prev` | Previous page (`.href`, `.text`) |
| `clp.next` | Next page (`.href`, `.text`) |
| `clp.translations` | Translation links (`.lang`, `.name`, `.flag`, `.url`) |
| `clp.listing` | Listing items (for listing pages) |
| `clp.listing_type` | Listing layout: `default`, `table`, or `grid` |
| `clp.pagination` | Pagination (`.current`, `.total`, `.prev_url`, `.next_url`) |
| `cfg.sidebar` | Show/hide sidebar |
| `cfg.toc` | Show/hide table of contents |

The `link()` function resolves relative URLs: `{{ link('assets/style.css') }}`.

### PageNode structure

Used by `clp.pages` in sidebar and book templates:

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `.title` | Page or section title |
| `.href` | URL (website) |
| `.file` | Output filename (book) |
| `.active` | Whether this is the current page |
| `.children` | Nested child nodes |


## Book templates

Book main templates (`main.tex`, `main.typ`) receive:

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `cfg.title` | Book title |
| `cfg.subtitle` | Book subtitle |
| `cfg.authors` | Author list (same structure as document authors) |
| `pages` | Page tree (list of `PageNode` with `.title`, `.file`, `.children`) |

Chapter templates (`chapter.tex`, `chapter.typ`) receive `clp.body`.


## Body variables

Available when writing Jinja expressions in `.qmd` files:

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `cfg.title`, `cfg.date`, ... | Front matter fields |
| `cfg.key.subkey` | Nested front matter fields |
| `cfg.target` | Current target name |
| `clp.writer` | Output format (`html`, `latex`, `typst`, `markdown`) |
| `env.HOME`, `env.USER`, ... | System environment variables |
